svg.text: A field on the half grid, moved to more points
f = sin θ + 0.3 cos 3θ − 0.2 sin 5θ, odd under θ → θ + π: 8 points on the half period hold it; the Resampler moves it to 64
θ = π: the half grid ends
Long segments split into blocks of their own
Planted on [0, 2] at order 16: split_segments at 20 steps cuts each segment at its step points; every old row keeps its bits
largest block 79 → 20 steps (-74.7%); the new nodes add rows, 65 → 145
